name: po-w4
prompt:
In web/src/api/mock.ts (the demo server), add the PROJ-OVERVIEW overview.
1. Directly after the line `const devSettings: Record<string, DevSettings> = {};` add the demo texts:
// PROJ-OVERVIEW: each project's About text and links (the demo keeps them beside the project list).
const overviewText: Record<string, { about: string; links: import("./types").ProjectLink[] }> = {
  "p-kk": {
    about: "A small C++17 engine with a Vulkan renderer, made for Kees's own games.\n\n" +
      "It keeps the editor, the asset pipeline and the runtime in one repo, so a game can be built and tested from Kompanion. " +
      "The renderer targets desktop Linux and Windows first; consoles are out of scope.\n\n" +
      "## Goals\n\n- Fast iteration: a scene reloads in under a second\n- Tests for every system\n- Screenshots for every visual change",
    links: [{ label: "Repo", url: "https://git.kreative-kompas.com/khyretos/kk-engine" }],
  },
};
2. Directly ABOVE the method `async getDevSettings(projectId: string) {` add the method `async getOverview(projectId: string): Promise<import("./types").ProjectOverview>` that builds the overview from the demo data:
- p = projects.find((x) => x.id === projectId); when missing throw new Error("No such project."). text = overviewText[projectId] ?? { about: "", links: [] }.
- m = p.repoMachineId ? machines.find((x) => x.id === p.repoMachineId) : undefined; folder = p.repoFolder ?? null.
- where: { machine: m ? { id: m.id, name: m.name, online: m.online, os: m.os || null } : null, folder, git: m ? { remote: `https://git.kreative-kompas.com/khyretos/${p.name}`, branch: "main", at: ago(5) } : null, gitState: m ? "known" : "none" }.
- grants: when m and folder: (grants[m.id] ?? []).filter((g) => g.target.startsWith("/") && (folder === g.target || folder.startsWith(g.target + "/"))).map((g) => ({ target: g.target, rights: g.rights, expires: g.expires })), else [].
- dev = devSettings[projectId] ?? emptyDev(); commands: when m: (["build", "test", "run", "deploy"] as const).filter((k) => dev[k].trim()).map((k) => ({ kind: k, command: dev[k], last: dev.last[k] ?? null, fromHere: k !== "deploy" })), else [].
- access: { grants, mcp: [{ server: "Blender", tool: "*", expires: hoursFromNow(48) }], knowledge: [], assets: (projectAssets[projectId] ?? []).length, commands }.
- mine = tasks.filter((t) => t.projectId === projectId); progress: { done: state done, total: mine.length, running: state running, needsYou: state needs_input or failed, inReview: state in_review, goals: [], next: the first 3 with state queued as { id, title, ready: true }, lastMerged: null } (counts are numbers).
- activity: every event of every task in mine as { what: `${t.title}: ${"text" in e ? e.text : e.kind}`, at: e.at, who: t.model }, plus each chat with chat.projectId === projectId as { what: `Chat: ${c.title}`, at: c.updatedAt, who: "" }; sort newest first by at (b.at.localeCompare(a.at)) and keep 10.
- ai: mine.length ? [{ model: "Qwen3.5-9B", runs: 4, tokens: 182000, minutes: 12.5 }, { model: "DeepSeek V3", runs: 1, tokens: 24000, minutes: 1.2 }] : [].
- Return structuredClone of { id: p.id, name: p.name, description: p.description, about: text.about, type: p.type ?? "chat", kind: p.kind ?? "internal", source: null, links: text.links, createdAt: ago(60 * 24 * 30), updatedAt: p.updatedAt, archivedAt: p.archivedAt ?? null, owner: "kees", where, access, progress, activity, ai, automation: { scheduler: { enabled: false, budget: { minutes: null, rounds: null, tokens: null } }, overseer: !!p.overseer }, errors: {} }.
Change nothing else.
